query: What review signals predict negative Amazon product satisfaction?

per_column.name: complaint_category
per_column.rationale: The presence/type of complaint is a review signal that lies outside the pos/neg label and is not a deterministic restatement of it (a review can complain yet be net positive, or be positive with no complaint). It plausibly carries strong predictive signal about dissatisfaction while remaining a distinct extracted feature.

per_column.name: performance_gap
per_column.rationale: Captures whether the product met/fell below spec or made misleading claims. This is a substantive content-derived signal distinct from the satisfaction label; meeting spec vs below spec is a legitimate predictor of satisfaction rather than a mere relabeling of it.

per_column.name: disappointment_intensity
per_column.rationale: Disappointment intensity is essentially the affective magnitude of (dis)satisfaction itself. It is close to a direct restatement/graded version of the focus label rather than an independent predictor, so it risks leaking the outcome it is meant to predict.

per_column.name: complaint_scope
per_column.rationale: Scope of the complaint (entire product vs specific feature vs seller) is a structural attribute of the review content that is not identical to the label and can plausibly refine prediction of overall satisfaction while remaining a separable feature.

per_column.name: return_action_signal
per_column.rationale: Behavioral intent such as returning, requesting a refund, or warning others is a review-expressed signal distinct from the numeric satisfaction label. It correlates with dissatisfaction but is a separately observable action, functioning as a legitimate predictor rather than a definitional restatement.

judge.rationale: Four of the five columns are extracted content signals (complaint type, performance gap, complaint scope, return/warning behavior) that lie outside the label and plausibly carry predictive leverage about satisfaction, so as a set they offer meaningful signal beyond raw title/content. However these features are heavily correlated with each other and with negativity, and 'disappointment_intensity' is effectively a graded restatement of the outcome (borderline leakage), which caps the genuine incremental leverage. Net predictive utility is moderate.
